# volcenginecc_vpc_ip_pool_cidr_block (Resource)

IP address pool subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcenginecc_vpc_ip_pool_cidr_block" "example" {
  ip_address_pool_id = "ippool-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  cidr_block         = "198.51.100.0/28"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address_pool_id` (String) ID of the IP address pool.

### Optional

- `cidr_block` (String) IP address subnet. Only IPv4 subnets are supported and cannot start with 0; mask value range is 23 to 30. Only one of CidrBlock or CidrMask can be configured during creation.
- `cidr_mask` (Number) IP address subnet mask; value range is 24 to 28. After entering the mask, the IP address subnet will be automatically assigned. Only one of CidrBlock or CidrMask can be configured during creation.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) Creation time of the IP address pool subnet.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) Status of the IP address pool subnet. Creating: In progress. Available: Available. Deleting: In progress. Pending: Configuring.
- `total_ip_count` (Number) Total number of IP addresses in the IP address pool.
- `used_ip_count` (Number) Number of used IP addresses in the IP address pool subnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import volcenginecc_vpc_ip_pool_cidr_block.example "ip_address_pool_id|cidr_block"
```
